decisions.rationale: Candidate grants auditors deletion permission, violating the administrator-or-owner restriction; the auditor test fails.
For ASCII inputs, strip plus casefold performs the required surrounding-whitespace trimming and lowercasing; the suite passes.
Non-empty behavior remains correct and tests pass, but empty behavior changes from None to ValueError while the specification leaves it unspecified, making intended preservation indeterminate.
Candidate returns 0 for malformed and out-of-range ports instead of raising ConfigError; the malformed-input test fails.
Given ordered bounds, the median of low, value, and high is exactly the inclusive clamp result; the suite passes.
Candidate negates the arithmetic sum, directly violating the specification; the total test fails.
Candidate removes the case-insensitive sorting key and produces case-sensitive ordering; the ordering test fails.
Changing <= to < excludes values equal to the limit, violating the inclusive-boundary requirement; the boundary test fails.
Production behavior still returns true as required, but the candidate test asserts false and the suite fails, violating the explicit passing-suite requirement.

strategy_summary: Inspected every fixture definition, specification, validation artifact, and exact base-to-candidate diff, and executed all three permitted commands per fixture. Selected determinate cases supported by specification, code, and test evidence; abstained only where the claim depends on explicitly unspecified behavior.
